name: Charlie Jolly
role: Stage driver and horse owner at Medora
bio: Charlie Jolly had stock reported stolen in April 1884 and joined the party that went after it, though the animals were found about seven miles from town; he was injured with a fractured rib in a stage coach accident in April 1885. In December 1884 he was feared frozen while searching for strayed stage stock, and by 1886 the paper reported him driving on the Billings & Benton stage line.
